beats.text: He inherited half the world at sixteen. He couldn't speak its language.
Charles was born in Ghent in 1500: grandson of Isabella and Ferdinand of Spain, and of the Holy Roman Emperor.
beats.say: Charles was born in Ghent in fifteen hundred: grandson of Isabella and Ferdinand of Spain, and of the Holy Roman Emperor.

beats.text: One by one, the heirs ahead of him died. He inherited Spain, the Netherlands, southern Italy, and the new lands across the ocean.
His mother, Queen Joanna, was declared unfit to rule, and kept shut away for forty-six years.
So at sixteen, Charles became king of Spain. He barely spoke Spanish.
Three years later, with loans from the Fugger bankers, he bought the votes that made him Holy Roman Emperor.
His motto was Plus Ultra: further beyond, around the Pillars of Hercules. It is still on Spain's flag today.
But Castile hated its foreign king. The cities rose up. At Villalar the rebels were crushed, and their leaders beheaded.
That same month in Germany, a monk named Martin Luther stood before him, and refused to take back a single word.
And across the ocean, a few hundred Spaniards were about to bring down an empire.
